description: A practical, documented 2/1 Game Forcing system using five-card majors, a 15–17 1NT, forcing 1NT responses to major openings, inverted minor-style raises, and explicit auction-progress facts.
notes: Ranges are HCP unless an explanation says otherwise. Core agreements follow Bridge World Standard 2017 and ACBL teaching references; judgment, vulnerability, seat, and partnership style can alter marginal opening and preempt decisions. Artificial or contextual calls explicitly carry an unrestricted 0–40 HCP range and no natural suit-length promise.

conventions.label: 2/1 game force
conventions.description: After an uncontested 1♦, 1♥, or 1♠ opening: 1♦–2♣; 1♥–2♣/2♦; 1♠–2♣/2♦/2♥. The response is a non-jump new suit and commits the partnership to game.

conventions.label: Forcing 1NT
conventions.description: The 1NT response to a major opening is forcing for one round in the base structure.

conventions.label: Stayman and transfers
conventions.description: Use 2♣ Stayman and 2♦/2♥ Jacoby transfers after 1NT.

priorityPolicy.rule: 2/1 game force is highest priority only for an uncontested non-jump new-suit response at the two level that is lower ranking than the opening suit.
